# 2026

The literature shifted from basic feasibility toward provenance, reflexivity, source/participant coverage, disagreement, calibration, sensitive-domain failures, and purpose-built evaluation—including direct evidence that agreement need not imply quality. Peer-reviewed studies increased, but a large preprint frontier remains.

Files are alphabetized by title, not by an invented month/day. Status is encoded in every filename.
